issue.title: [High][NATIVE-019] Android camera loses its output URI across Activity/process recreation

repository.name: nativeCmpkit
repository.description: Independent Kotlin Multiplatform native component toolkit, derived from Calf with preserved Apache-2.0 attribution and history.

issue.body:
<!-- nativecmpkit-item:audit:NATIVE-019 -->
## Classification
- **Finding:** NATIVE-019
- **Priority:** High
- **Evidence status:** `confirmed-source` (source/test evidence is not automatically a demonstrated exploit)
- **Affected modules:** `calf-camera-picker`
- **Estimated complexity:** M
- **Reviewed upstream baseline:** `af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6`; original commit preserved in this repository.

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-camera-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/camerapicker/CameraPickerLauncher.android.kt:28,35-48,59-73`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-camera-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/camerapicker/CameraPickerLauncher.android.kt#L28) — `imageUri and rememberCameraPickerLauncher`

## Root cause
The pending image URI is stored only inside a newly remembered CameraPickerLauncherAndroidImpl. ActivityResultRegistry can deliver a restored TakePicture Boolean, but the recreated instance has imageUri=null and drops the successful result.

## Impact and preconditions
Capturing a photo while the host Activity is recreated or process is reclaimed loses the application result and leaves the camera-created file orphaned. The most important user action can appear to succeed in the camera app but disappear on return.

## Supporting evidence
- imageUri initializes null at28; only launch assigns it at42; handleResult requires non-null at47.
- remember rather than rememberSaveable is used for both holder and launcher.

## Recommended solution
Persist the pending output URI/request state with saveable state or an explicit saved-state owner before launching. Restore it before result delivery, clear it after terminal completion and handle interrupted requests deliberately.

## Risks and compatibility
This is a source-traced lifecycle defect; no Android device/emulator Activity recreation test was run by this reviewer. Do not persist a granted URI longer than its actual access lifetime without an ownership policy.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Enable dont-keep-activities, launch camera, capture, return and receive exactly one readable KmpFile.
- Rotate/recreate and simulate process death while external camera is foreground.
- Cancelled/restored requests remove only library-owned temporary files and do not deliver stale URI.

## Dependencies
- None identified.

## Historical context
- https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/274
- https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/302

issue.title: [Medium][NATIVE-021] Camera API silently drops unsupported, cancelled and failed operations

repository.name: nativeCmpkit
repository.description: Independent Kotlin Multiplatform native component toolkit, derived from Calf with preserved Apache-2.0 attribution and history.

issue.body:
<!-- nativecmpkit-item:audit:NATIVE-021 -->
## Classification
- **Finding:** NATIVE-021
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Evidence status:** `confirmed-source` (source/test evidence is not automatically a demonstrated exploit)
- **Affected modules:** `calf-camera-picker`
- **Estimated complexity:** M
- **Reviewed upstream baseline:** `af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6`; original commit preserved in this repository.

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-camera-picker/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/camerapicker/CameraPickerLauncher.kt:7-14`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-camera-picker/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/camerapicker/CameraPickerLauncher.kt#L7-L14) — `CameraPickerLauncher and onResult contract`
- [`calf-camera-picker/src/desktopMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/camerapicker/CameraPickerLauncher.desktop.kt:8-19`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-camera-picker/src/desktopMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/camerapicker/CameraPickerLauncher.desktop.kt#L8-L19) — `Desktop no-op launcher`
- [`calf-camera-picker/src/webMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/camerapicker/CameraPickerLauncher.web.kt:8-19`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-camera-picker/src/webMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/camerapicker/CameraPickerLauncher.web.kt#L8-L19) — `Web no-op launcher`
- [`calf-camera-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/camerapicker/CameraPickerLauncher.android.kt:30-49`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-camera-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/camerapicker/CameraPickerLauncher.android.kt#L30-L49) — `launch/handleResult`
- [`calf-camera-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/camerapicker/CameraPickerLauncher.ios.kt:57-76`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-camera-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/camerapicker/CameraPickerLauncher.ios.kt#L57-L76) — `finish/cancel delegate`

## Root cause
Only a non-null KmpFile success callback is modeled. Desktop/Web launch are Unit no-ops; Android no-camera/cancel returns nothing; iOS cancel, image-conversion and write failures all disappear without an outcome. Other launch exceptions escape instead.

## Impact and preconditions
Callers cannot reliably clear busy UI, distinguish denial/cancellation/unavailable from a pending picker, or feature-detect desktop/web. Common availability is misleading despite compilation succeeding.

## Supporting evidence
- Desktop/Web launch bodies are literally Unit; error/cancel paths in mobile have no callback.
- Upstream request288 is source-satisfied for basic mobile capture, not desktop/web.

## Recommended solution
Add a result/capability API covering success, cancellation, unavailable and categorized failure, while keeping the legacy success-only callback as an adapter. Do not pretend unsupported platforms captured an image. Document permission requirements and iOS photo-library fallback.

## Risks and compatibility
Adding cases to existing public sealed types can break exhaustive callers; this API currently has no result type, so use an additive overload/type and migration guidance. Do not silently implement a major camera engine during this audit.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Every platform produces one defined terminal outcome for cancel/unavailable/error.
- No camera app, feature absent, permission denied and iOS simulator library fallback.
- Desktop/Web capability checks align with launcher behavior.

## Dependencies
- None identified.

## Historical context
- https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/issues/28
- https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/issues/288
- https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/274

issue.title: [Medium][NATIVE-022] Android camera hardcodes a host FileProvider authority without public setup or validation

repository.name: nativeCmpkit
repository.description: Independent Kotlin Multiplatform native component toolkit, derived from Calf with preserved Apache-2.0 attribution and history.

issue.body:
<!-- nativecmpkit-item:audit:NATIVE-022 -->
## Classification
- **Finding:** NATIVE-022
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Evidence status:** `confirmed-source` (source/test evidence is not automatically a demonstrated exploit)
- **Affected modules:** `calf-camera-picker`
- **Estimated complexity:** M
- **Reviewed upstream baseline:** `af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6`; original commit preserved in this repository.

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-camera-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/camerapicker/CameraPickerLauncher.android.kt:35-43`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-camera-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/camerapicker/CameraPickerLauncher.android.kt#L35-L43) — `launch FileProvider URI creation`
- [`sample/android/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:58-66`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/sample/android/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml#L58-L66) — `sample FileProvider registration`
- [`sample/android/src/main/res/xml/filepaths.xml:2-6`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/sample/android/src/main/res/xml/filepaths.xml#L2-L6) — `whole-cache provider path`

## Root cause
API24+ requires ${context.packageName}.provider and a provider path covering cacheDir, but the library ships no manifest/provider contract or dedicated camera setup guide. getUriForFile and launcher.launch are outside error handling. A device camera feature does not ensure an installed intent handler.

## Impact and preconditions
A host adding only the artifact can crash on first launch with missing provider metadata or unmatched path. Authority collisions or host-custom providers cannot be selected. Copying the sample exposes the whole cache tree as grantable rather than a camera-only subdirectory.

## Supporting evidence
- No camera AndroidManifest.xml exists in the baseline.
- Setup details survive in upstream PR274 body, while the current sample is the only in-repository provider example.

## Recommended solution
Document/validate a configurable authority/output provider, reserve a narrow camera cache subdirectory, and return explicit configuration/launch failure. If a manifest provider is bundled later, use a namespaced authority and preserve host override/backward compatibility.

## Risks and compatibility
The sample provider is exported=false with temporary grants: whole-cache path is not proof all cache files are publicly readable. Treat narrowing as defense in depth, not an existing unauthenticated data leak.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Minimal consuming app with correct/missing/wrong provider setup on API23 and24+.
- Host with its own provider authority and no installed camera intent handler.
- Only camera-owned files can be granted through recommended provider configuration.

## Dependencies
- None identified.

## Historical context
- https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/274
